notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other black creatures.
description:
Cast Crystal Spray by paying {2}{U}, changing all instances of "white" on Teysa to "black" until end of turn, and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Teysa by sacrificing three black creatures, targeting any creature.
The creatures die, triggering Teysa three times, creating three 1/1 black Spirit creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.
